label: Muzzle taper

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #3 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: taper index: 0.50 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.40 -> -100 = 0.10, +100 = 0.90 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.50) / 0.40)

region.mask_rule: rostrum block, width gradient from base to nose end; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Nose-end width versus muzzle-base width: + = pointier (fox +35, fennec +40), - = blockier (cat -20). An index, not a ratio of L. A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
